mapper.sql: select id, shop_code, productioncode as production_code, sourcetype as source_type, sourceordercodes as source_order_codes, orderallocation as order_allocation, productcode as product_code, productname as product_name, planyqty as plan_y_qty, actualyqty as actual_y_qty, plandate as plan_date, actualdate as actual_date, status, materialcost as material_cost, processingcost as processing_cost, freightcost as freight_cost, othercost as other_cost, totalcost as total_cost, unitcost as unit_cost, createuser as create_user, createtime as create_time, updateuser as update_user, updatetime as update_time, remark from sdsshop.u_p_production
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_p_production set sourcetype = #{sourceType}, sourceordercodes = #{sourceOrderCodes}, orderallocation = #{orderAllocation}, productcode = #{productCode}, productname = #{productName}, planyqty = #{planYQty}, plandate = #{planDate}, remark = #{remark}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and id = #{id} and status = '待生产'

update sdsshop.u_p_production set status = #{status}, actualyqty = #{actualQty}, actualdate = #{actualDate}, materialcost = #{materialCost}, totalcost = #{totalCost}, unitcost = #{unitCost}, processingcost = #{processingCost}, freightcost = #{freightCost}, othercost = #{otherCost}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and productioncode = #{productionCode} and status = #{expectStatus}

update sdsshop.u_p_production set totalcost = #{totalCost}, unitcost = #{unitCost}, processingcost = #{processingCost}, freightcost = #{freightCost}, othercost = #{otherCost}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and productioncode = #{productionCode}
mapper.select: where shop_code = #{shopCode} and sourcetype = 'order' and (find_in_set(#{orderCode}, sourceordercodes) > 0 or orderallocation like concat('%"orderCode":"', #{orderCode}, '"%')) order by createtime desc, productioncode desc

select count(1) from sdsshop.u_p_production where shop_code = #{shopCode} and sourcetype = 'order' and status not in ('已完工', '已关闭') and (find_in_set(#{orderCode}, sourceordercodes) > 0 or orderallocation like concat('%"orderCode":"', #{orderCode}, '"%'))
